sloka: अर्थतश्च मया प्राप्ता देवराज्यादयो गुणाः ।हतशत्रुं विजयिनं रामं पश्यामि सुस्थितम् ।। ६.११६.२५ ।।
transliteration: arthataśca mayā prāptā devarājyādayo guṇāḥ ।hataśatruṁ vijayinaṁ rāmaṁ paśyāmi susthitam ।। 6.116.25 ।।

translations.english: Hearing the words of Mythili, daughter of Janaka, Hanuman spoke these auspicious words.
